steps.eval: (async()=>{ window.__until=async(fn,ms)=>{const t0=performance.now(); while(performance.now()-t0<ms){ const r=fn(); if(r) return r; await new Promise(q=>setTimeout(q,100)); } return null;}; const f=__rhf.game.fishing; __rhf.press('primary'); await __until(()=>f.state==='meter',60000); return 'cast: '+f.state; })()

(async()=>{const f=__rhf.game.fishing; f.meter.t = Math.pow(0.6,1/1.3)*1.15 - 0.1; __rhf.press('primary'); await __until(()=>f.meter.phase===1||f.state!=='meter',60000); return 'power press: phase '+f.meter.phase+', power '+f.meter.power.toFixed(2); })()

(async()=>{const f=__rhf.game.fishing; const m=f.meter; if(f.state==='meter'&&m.phase===1){ m.t=0.5/f.timing.speed-0.05; __rhf.press('primary'); } await __until(()=>f.state!=='meter',60000); return 'accuracy press: '+f.state; })()

(async()=>{const f=__rhf.game.fishing; for(let i=0;i<400;i++){ if(f.encounter && f.encounter.phase==='bite'){ __rhf.press('primary'); return 'hooked at '+i; } if(f.encounter && f.encounter.phase==='approach'){ f.encounter.t=f.encounter.dur; } if(f.encounter && f.encounter.phase==='nibble'){ f.encounter.nibbles=0; f.encounter.gap=0; } await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50)); } return 'no bite '+f.state})()

(async()=>{const f=__rhf.game.fishing; const t0=performance.now(); while(f.state==='fight'&&performance.now()-t0<300000){ const F=f.fight; F.stamina=0.2; F.dist=Math.min(F.dist,3); F.state='tired'; F.stateT=5; __rhf.hold('primary', true); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60)); } __rhf.hold('primary', false); return 'state '+f.state})()
